svg.title: LCD dot matrix to display RAM
svg.desc: Each LCD column is one byte split over two nibbles; four quadrants run in different directions.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 32 × 16 dots + 8 icons. One column = one byte = two nibbles (odd nibble = upper 4 dots, bit 3 at the top).
